international.title: Florida to carry out record-breaking 20th execution of the year
international.summary: State to execute man convicted of two counts of first-degree murder while Texas also plans to put a man to death Florida is set Thursday to carry out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year on a man convicted of killing a pregnant woman and her husband during a home invasion, while Texas plans to put a man to death for the killing of a Houston jeweler during a $3.6m diamond heist. Thomas Mitchell Overton, 71, was scheduled to receive a three-drug injection at 6pm at Florida state prison in Raiford. Reinaldo Dennes, 70, was set to receive a lethal injection about an hour later at a prison in Texas and become the ninth person executed by that state this year. The planned executions of the two septuagenarians in one day reflect the ageing of the US death row population. Continue reading...
